svg.title: Shoulder bone and joint problems: AC joint separation versus AC osteoarthritis by onset; glenohumeral arthritis split by passive motion and cuff strength into noninflammatory and inflammatory; instability split by trauma into traumatic and atraumatic; and adhesive capsulitis with global stiffness and a normal X-ray; each with presentation, examination and X-ray, and treatment in order
